items.title: Fair Isaac (FICO) Wins A Fresh Auto Score 10 Upgrade From A Regional Lender
items.summary: Fair Isaac (NYSE:FICO) reported that Arvest Bank has adopted the FICO Auto Score 10 credit scoring model. The regional lender integrated Auto Score 10 into its auto lending workflows, aiming for finer borrower segmentation and credit risk assessment. FICO highlighted that Arvest completed the upgrade while maintaining operational continuity across its existing lending processes. Fair Isaac's traction with Arvest on Auto Score 10 is one piece of a bigger story investors should weigh...
